The old ascending rebuild (head = highest slot) reversed every first-hit tie: mc2l3 t=268, the possession bolt's endpoint cell (106,196) chains firebug 152 -> sphere 137 -> sphere 241; retail's claim probe passes 152 and CLAIMS 137, the canonical chain served 241 first — the bolt snapped to the wrong sphere and the (10,12) claim pulse minted 105/69/68 units off (slots 131+250 x/y/z, the first divergent pair).

THE BALLOON TARGET READ IS IDENTITY-BLIND: AddBallon_60AB0 (EF:61779) gates only on target96 != 0 - no liveness, reap-mark or model test - re-bears (atan2) at the target record every tick and runs the LABEL_20 altitude servo even when the class-10 'ours' test (@0x94 vs the balloon's @0x1A) skips the move. mc2l3 t=343: balloon 162's target sphere 231 was reaped and re-minted as a (10,86) earlier in the SAME tick; retail re-bears at the new tenant (yaw 300) and settles z -16; the port's invented reap-mark gate (flags & 0x400 == 0) plus the model-39 stale-slot guard (clear f146 and return) skipped the whole tick (yaw 1728 held, z 1831, target cleared). The same two guards MC1's balloon mover shed 2026-08-12 (DEVIATIONS castle_balloons: 'the mover is BLIND'); both removed, the gate is now t != 0 alone (bounds-clamped), the recycled-record absorb is retail's own latent bug and the port's law.

A FREED MC2 SLOT IS NOT AN EMPTY SLOT (the MC1 importer's blind-tracker law, MC2 face): retail's free path clears the class byte and pushes the stack - every other byte stays - and blind target reads steer at whatever the record still holds. mc2l3 t=354: balloon 162's target96 = 247, a freed (0,39) ex-sphere; retail chases the corpse's stale position (yaw 914 via the class-0 plain-move arm, x/y step toward the residue), and the castle's roster pass retargets it to live sphere 156 later in the same walk; the port's retail_import_mc2 defaulted every class-0 slot to zeros, re-aiming the balloon at the ORIGIN (yaw 1354, x/y stepping toward 0,0). The importer now imports freed slots' stale bytes (class 0, not counted active, bad-row stand-in 59) - the exact block shape of the MC1 importer's freed-slot arm.

THE OBJECTIVE BOARD IS A GLOBAL AND IT WAS NEVER IMPORTED: retail's per-player struct_0x3659C[8] (LS:190-96, stride 11 = IsLevelEnd + row cursor + the m32 one-pass pause + stage_0x3659F[8]) is read and written by sub_58F00_game_objectives at the frame tail (EF:40693) and gated on by the class-11 model-32 switches (stage_0x3659F[par1] == 2, EF:54369), so every pair ran the port's board as a free-running fiction and mc2l3 t=356 lost the WHOLE disposition-6 wave (17 records missing in port, and with them slot 53). The bytes were always in the capture: 0x3659C + 8*11 == 0x365F4, the stagevar base the decoder already read. The same pair pins the (10,11) scorch ring's subSpell home (@0x2A, EF:23510, not the dead @0x90) and the pack scan's tick-top roster walk (EF:9183 - model 20's roster is EMPTY for the rest of the frame the wave mints into, so retail's newborn finds no leader and stays at action 161).

THE BALLOON SPHERE IS THE LAST POP OF A CASTLE-DEATH BURST: sub_5FCA0 (EF:61222-31) is a straight line sub_605E0 -> actionIndex=4 -> sub_5FD00 (the bank EJECTOR) -> sub_5FF50 (the ROSTER), and sub_605E0's level-0 death arm (EF:61645-61666) never touches the fleet - the balloons dissolve in sub_5FF50's v1<3 TAIL (EF:61436-45), which at quota 0 sweeps every register slot. So retail mints the BANK spheres first and the BALLOON sphere last. The port front-loaded the conversion into mc2_castle_downgrade's death arm (a REGISTERED deviation, DEVIATIONS 'mc2_castle_destroy (eject ordering)', now retired), which rotated the whole burst by one free-stack pop. mc2l3 t=584->585, castle 252 dies 1->0 holding 6300 = 6 x 1050 with fleet cargo 1200: retail pops 228,248,129,215,135,126 for the bank and 127 for the balloon; the port put the balloon sphere on 228 and every bank scatter slid one slot down, port[p_k] == retail[p_k-1] exactly. Retail slot 127: yaw 1306 = (25497 % 0x71 + 1290 - 56) & 0x7FF, speed 56, f2c 64 = (1024-512)/8.

CLASS 10'S @0x90 MANA LANE IS DEAD AND f140 IS THE PORT'S HOME FOR retail's subSpellIndex_0x2A_42: sub_507C0 (EF:36936) stamps the (10,66) PARALYZE ctor with subSpell 200 and the impact seam then overwrites BOTH sides' @0x2A with the flyer's carried payload (v11x->subSpellIndex_0x2A_42 = a1x->subSpellIndex_0x2A_42, EF:62993) - which is the amount mc2_debuff_stamp_tick mails. my_sign32 IS -1/0, NEVER +1: EF:23864's meteor quad is (768*ring - my_sign32(768*ring)*5) >> 2, and engine_support.cpp:2962 returns -1 for a negative and 0 otherwise - so the -5 is a NO-OP on the only branch the ring counter ever takes (it cycles 0..10 via (f26+2)%11) and an ADD of 5 on the negative one. Reading it as a signum subtracted 5 on the positive branch and cost 2 units per ring step in BOTH the apitch and aroll lanes at once. mc2l3 t=1341: slot 163's (10,17) at ring 2 wants 768*2 >> 2 = 384; the port published 382.

A LAUNCH AIMS FROM THE CASTER, NOT FROM THE LIFTED SPAWN POINT: every creature launch thunk holds v2 = &a1x->position_0x4C_76 - the CASTER's - and hands THAT to both sub_581E0_maybe_tan2 and sub_58210_radix_tan before touching the new record's z: sub_1CC20 (9,0) bolt EF:9697-99, sub_1CCE0 EF:9725-27, sub_1CDA0 arrow EF:9753-55, sub_1D1A0 (9,21) lob EF:9865-68 - which even SAVES the spawned z in v7, computes the pitch, and only then writes v7+128 back - sub_1D460's 5-shot fan EF:9962-66, and the doomsday launcher aiming from the AVATAR (EF:13497-501) while spawning 640 ahead at z+768. So the z-lift is applied AFTER the aim and must not tilt it. None of them writes roll_0x20_32 or fov_0x22_34 either: those are sub_655C0's LOCK (EF:62775-76), which the flyer's own first tick runs. mc2l3 t=1410: the m20 at (31785, 28647, 927) lobs a (9,21) at the human - retail's radix_tan from z 927 gives pitch 1907, the port's from the lifted 1055 gave 1915.

THE ONE-SHOT AIM ACQUISITION WALKS THE TICK-TOP ROSTERS, NOT THE LIVE POOL: sub_67CB0 (EF:54710) scans its candidate lists through the chains the tick-top sweep built - the class-3 roster dword_38519 (EF:54783/54862/54892/54937, admitted on life >= 0 ALONE), the per-model class-5 buckets bytearray_38403x (EF:39987-40008, life >= 0 and actionIndex not in {0xB4,0xE8,0xEA}), the building chain dword_38527, and bucket 22 - re-asking NONE of those questions at the walk. Every liveness test was settled when the roster was BUILT, so a candidate that dies mid-tick stays lockable for the rest of the frame and one already dead at the tick top is invisible however alive its record reads. The port walked the live pool in four of its five lists (only the sphere list had been converted), so it acquired a different target and the whole homing pose followed. mc2l3 t=2396: the (9,0) fireball at slot 152 bears 483 in retail where the port bore 494, carrying x/y/z/pitch with it. Same story at t=2400 on slot 159 - duplicate coverage, deliberately not cut. Ledger: 2026-08-23c.

MC2 POINT DAMAGE SNOWBALLS: sub_11900 (EF:4375) is MC2's single-target mailbox write and its two branches are the exact INVERSE of MC2's own AREA protocol at EF:4021-24 - it OVERWRITES while a source is still pending and ACCUMULATES onto the stale amount once a reader has cleared it. Readers clear the SOURCE and never the amount (EF:5407), so the residue is live ammunition, exactly like MC1's sub_12B50. Its callers are ALL of the three melee thunks sub_1CE80/sub_1CED0/sub_1CF20 (EF:9780/9794/9808) and the (10,65)/(10,66) debuff stamps' sub_38F70 (EF:28440); the port routed both through the area writer. mc2l3 t=2704: the human's inbox stands at (780, src 0) - consumed, residue standing - a (9,21) lob detonates into a (10,66) paralyze at slot 137 which mails 780 more, and the drain at slot 167 takes retail's accumulated 1560 where the port's overwrite left 780 (life 8440 v 9220).

THE MANA SPHERE HAS A CAVE-CEILING CLAMP: TransformArcherToMana_35940's tail (EF:26256-63) caps the stepped z at sub_10C60(pos) - array_0x52_82.fov and forces the lift to -abs(lift) - the ceiling twin of the ground rebound the port already carried, and MC2-ONLY because MC1 has no ceiling plane. It must land BEFORE the grounded test, whose retail form (v22 == pred.z, EF:26265) compares the terrain altitude against the FULLY clamped z. mc2l3 t=5424: sphere 234 arcs from z 2937 at lift -5 and retail parks it on 2913 - the ceiling less its own fov - where the port flew on to 2932.

A WEDGED MANA SPHERE FANS FOR AN OPENING, IT DOES NOT STOP: EF:26192-26239 - a sphere whose stepped position pokes the rock (sub_11E70, Terrain.cpp:2152) takes actSpeed 256 and searches +/-170 at a time out to +/-1020 (v30 alternating sign, v32 advancing only on the way back to +1), each candidate probed from the CURRENT position rather than the stepped one and dropped onto the terrain; the first opening becomes BOTH the yaw and the roll. If all twelve poke, retail nudges +64/+64 and - its own quirk - leaves z at the LAST probe's terrain altitude, sampled at an x/y it then discards. Either way the lift is slammed to -128. Retail's v35 arm (skip the fan) is the COLLECTOR TETHER, which the port returns out of well above, so the ballistic path only ever runs with v35 = 0. mc2l3 t=5426: sphere 234 wedges under the rock and retail relaunches it at speed 256 on a fanned heading (x, y, z, heading and speed all move).

A BUILDING'S FOOTPRINT CLEAR SOFT-KILLS SCENERY, IT DOES NOT FREE IT: sub_57390's class-2 arm (EF:39763-66) is DisableEntityDrawing04_57F10 (EF:40332-35), a one-line byte[1] |= 4 = our 0x400 — the static stays a class-2 GHOST, still tile-linked and OFF the free stack, until the next tick-top reap or a mid-tick disposition fire sweeps it through mc2_rebuild_free's ghost loop, which hands the slots back ASCENDING. The port called free_entity, so 92/96/97 hit the free stack mid-tick and every later allocation rotated. mc2l3 t=5614: retail's dis-9 payload takes 92 for its (11,22) kill-watch where the port had already spent 92 on a mana sphere and 96 on a projectile — 0 missing / 0 extra, a pure permutation of 7 records over a fixed slot set. MC1's twin build_footprint_kill has carried the soft kill since mc1l0 t=3855.

THE M9 ARROW'S LAUNCH LIFT IS THE CASTER'S FOV EXTENT, NOT ITS ROLL - AND THE DECOMPILE SAYS OTHERWISE. sub_1CDA0 (EF:9756) reads `v3x->position_0x4C_76.z += a1x->array_0x52_82.roll;` and the measurement cannot be reconciled with it. mc2l3 t=5707: the m9 archer at slot 225 stands at z 1124 wearing the extent quad 128/86/86/128 and fires a (9,13) arrow into recycled slot 237. Every other lane of the launch is bit-exact on both sides - yaw 1111, pitch 1963, speed 384, x 47782, y 3240, the arrow's own quad 30/44/44/60 - so the whole 42-unit delta is in the BIRTH z: the same-tick flight step is (384 * SIN[1963]) >> 16 = -100, retail's final 1352 implies birth 1252 = 1124 + 128 (the .fov/.yaw member, +0x58), and the port's .roll (+0x56) = 86 gives the measured 1310. THE VALUE IS MEASURED; THE NOUN IS A THREE-WAY TIE THIS CORPUS CANNOT BREAK - SetEntityIndexAndRot_49CD0 (EF:32842-45) sets .yaw == .fov == rot_speed_8/2 and the m9 only ever wears rows 201/202 through that plain path, so .yaw, .fov and a literal 128 are indistinguishable here forever, and the immediate family does all three (sub_1CC20 EF:9699 .fov, sub_1CCE0 EF:9728 .fov/2, sub_1D1A0 EF:9847 a bare literal). .fov is chosen as the family idiom: EF:9756 is the ONLY `z += ....roll` in all 63,636 lines against 30+ .fov z-lifts, and it is one struct member away. Provenance checked - no //fix marker, and the line entered EventsFunctions.cpp via a file SPLIT commit, so it is most likely original decompiler output (a struct-member mis-attribution) rather than a hand edit. The ordering hypothesis was KILLED first: AddEventToMap_57D70 (EF:40315-29) copies the axis verbatim with no clamp, so pre-lifting into the ctor and lifting after it are the same computation. Also landed on the same thunk: sub_49E10(v3x, 203) (EF:9764) re-stamps the arrow's sprite row over the ctor's own 195, geometry-safe because rows 195/203 are both 18x24 in the day bank. Free run: mc2l3 5706 -> 6444. Ledger: 2026-08-24f.

A CREATURE DROPS ITS ATTACK RUN THE TICK THE PLAYER DIES: every caller of sub_1ED30 guards the resolved target with `v7x->life_0x8 < 0 || v7x->byte[1] & 4` (HitFirebug_25610 EF:16360) and nothing in that test knows the record is the human's — the carpet is a pool entity in retail like any other. The port's mc2_target short-circuited PLAYER_TARGET to an unconditional Some, so the liveness test that every pooled target got was the one the human never did. mc2l3 t=7885, the tick slot 167 takes life 230 -> -670: three (5,19) firebugs above the carpet's walk slot take retail's LABEL_92 — actionIndex 154 -> 153 (attack -> idle) and actSpeed -> minSpeed 76 — where the port held all three in the attack run. Wired through ctx.pdead, which already existed for exactly this and is now re-published mid-walk at the carpet's own dispatch so a creature ABOVE the carpet reads the death on its own tick.

THE MANA-MAGNET AURA'S RANGE IS A 32-BIT SQUARE AND THE DRAGGED SPHERE WRITES ITS OWN HEADING: sub_38D80 (EF:28371) compares the raw squared xy distance straight against dword_0x10_16, and every writer stores (k<<8)^2 - the ctor's 12,845,056 (EF:36825) and the possession impact's copy of the bolt's own value (EF:59053). The port's field home is the TILE RADIUS, and the importer's catch-all `as i16` truncated every multiple of 65536 to exactly 0, so EVERY imported aura ran at range 0 and dragged nothing. Paired with it, TransformArcherToMana_35940 has the SPHERE write yaw_0x1C_28 = tan2(sphere, aura) itself before it flies (EF:26101) - the MC1 ch4 twin already did this; the MC2 half threw the aura slot away. mc2l3 t=9816 slot 168: retail heading 960, port 0.

THE MC2 MANA TAIL IS PART OF THE CARPET'S DISPATCH: EF:59996-60033 applies manaRegen and RE-SELECTS it at the end of AddPlayer03_00_5E010, so a token BELOW the carpet stamps mana_delta and this apply lands it in the same frame while one ABOVE pays next frame — retail's below-carpet ordering law itself, where the port applied at the TOP of the turn and faked the phase with three stashes (mc2_applied_regen's take-back, the mc2_regen_owed pay-back window, and mc2_gate_purse so the cast gate could still read the pre-apply purse; all three deleted). mc2l3 t=10296: the human reads life 9540 where the pre-walk apply left 9535. A/B-attributed — reverting only the tail's placement puts this pair dirty again and leaves t=644 and mc2l0 t=4133 clean.

THE M20'S STATE-2 HEAD IS A BARE POINTER TEST: sub_25E40 (EF:16661-66) validates word_0x96_150 with `Entities_EA3E4[target] <= Entities_EA3E4[0]` and NOTHING else — no class test, no life test, no reap test. The port asked mc2_target, which carries all three, and so dropped out of action 162 on a target the chase would still have honoured.
